concepts.prompt: Every view shows the complete piece from a slightly elevated three-quarter angle: front three-quarter, side, and rear three-quarter views. A cliff-edge town quarter as ONE single compact object, 32 metres wide, 22 metres deep and 26 metres tall: two stacked tiers of pale stratified limestone rock with horizontal rock layers and moss, the lower 12 metres a solid vertical rock cliff face, the upper tier stepped back. Three two-storey stone houses in exactly the style of the stone row house reference sit on the tiers: one on the lower ledge in front, two on the higher tier behind, all coursed pale limestone ashlar with corner quoins, steep slate-blue tiled gable roofs with dormers, tall pointed-arch windows with warm amber glass, arched honey-timber doors and small honey-timber balconies. A stone stair with a stone baluster balustrade climbs the rock face between the tiers like the terrace stair reference, and one short honey-timber plank bridge with rope rails links the two tiers. A royal-blue wing banner hangs on one house. The back and the lower half are rock, so it reads as built into a cliff edge. Stylised-realism game asset in the Palworld / Animo art style, single isolated object on a plain neutral background, even soft daylight, no surrounding landscape beyond the piece itself, no clouds, no sky, no people. Materials: pale warm-grey weathered limestone ashlar (#a89c8a to #c4b8a4, never pure white) in coursed blocks with soft moss in the joints; slate-blue roof tile (#3d4a66); gilded gold ribs and accents (#c9a24a); royal-blue fabric banners with a white and gold wing emblem; honey-coloured timber only for doors, balconies and planks; warm amber window glass as a distinct saturated colour. Absolutely no red, no oxblood, no maroon, no pink anywhere. No half-timbering, no cream plaster, no thatch. Flat ground contact at the base.
